summary: A second Baidu source, baidu_web: Baidu AI Search (POST /v2/ai_search/web_search) restricted to xueshu.baidu.com, because the Baidu Scholar tool answers 404 for the owner's account. It shares the Qianfan key of Baidu Scholar (SourceInfo.key_shared_with; one key file, one field in Settings) and has its own switch, daily counter (cap 40), 24 h cache and status. Wired into the daily feed (Chinese projects with Chinese keywords), project-creation candidates and typed seed titles; papers both Baidu sources find are deduplicated by key and title; a Baidu Scholar failure never stops the web search. The parser is built on a trimmed real answer. Also records the Wanfang evaluation (paid, 10-day trial: considered, not adopted; no adapter). Follow-up after the independent review: the two Baidu sources share ONE daily counter (40 in total); the status line shows the most actionable kind; a plausible 年份 decides the year of `published`; a per-second limit (QPS, HTTP 429 without a daily-allowance body) is transient, not 'quota used up'; whole-word limit/rate matching; markers counted in order at their first occurrence; every non-ASCII character counts 2 of the 72 units; lone surrogates stripped; one source's unexpected exception is only that source's failure; string-only fields; no merging on empty title marks; echoed keys removed from errors; the Baidu settings regrouped into one block (heading, one key line, two switches); the shared confirm dialog centred. Third commit: the Baidu settings block has one 测试 button on the key line, which tests baidu_web; the two switches are only checkboxes.
scope_note: Worktree baidu-web on main 582ce17. Critical: a new outbound request and provider adapter, a shared secret, new settings. Data sharing is the same as the already-approved Baidu Scholar source (owner approvals quoted in ADR 0039 and its 2026-10-23 addendum; owner_approved stays false). No migration, no model call, no network call in any test; no real database or key touched. Second commit on the same branch (follow-up to 7f5e3fe). Third commit (settings key-line test targets baidu_web).

budget_impact.rationale: No model call or token. At most one extra Baidu request per Chinese keyword/query when the web switch is on and the shared key is saved (up to 3 per project refresh, one per creation phrase, one per typed seed search), counted in its own local cap of 40 a day and answered from a 24 h cache when repeated. Baidu's own allowance is 1500 free calls a month; billing after that is unverified (owner to-do).
budget_impact.before: only Baidu Scholar (404 for the owner's account) could add Chinese papers
budget_impact.after: same model cost (zero); one extra Baidu request per Chinese search when the web switch is on

reviews.reviewer: Separate review agent (Opus), read-only; no blocking finding; should-fix and nit findings fixed in the follow-up commit
Implementing agent (Sonnet); not independent (first commit and follow-up)

open_risks: The error response shape of the Baidu AI Search, the meaning of its `date` field, billing after the 1500 free calls a month, whether Baidu's 429 body ever names the daily allowance (a 429 is now treated as per-second unless it does) and whether the site filter becomes a paid feature are UNVERIFIED (owner to-do: keep billing off or confirm in the Qianfan console).

Only one real answer (7 references for one query, 2026-10-23) was available: how often content lacks an abstract or keywords, and how many papers a query returns, is unmeasured. The two Baidu sources may use different ids for the same paper, so the same paper can occasionally be stored twice on different days.
The settings row was tested with Node virtual pages only, not in a browser; no real key was used by this change, so tools/source_smoke.py baidu_web has not been run against Baidu.
The follow-up fixes themselves were not independently re-reviewed.
The Baidu settings block was tested with Node virtual pages only in this follow-up (the coordinator saw the previous layout in a real browser).
